change.summary: Add a derived, non-runtime combat inventory, formula lookup, scenario model, honest coverage report and deterministic review warnings.

before.reason: Combat evidence was distributed across registry partitions and owning sources.

after.model: Original -> Modifiers -> JEM tweaks -> Effective -> Acquisition -> Assessment

modifiers.notes: The generated view is evidence only. Unknown values stay unresolved and warnings never auto-balance gameplay.

rationale.purpose: Make every combat candidate findable and every claimed power expression traceable without duplicating runtime ownership or fabricating missing values.
rationale.decision_source: User-supplied CODEX TASK — JEM Universal Power Balance System

introduced.summary: Created the permanent power-system documentation and source-derived power views without changing production gameplay.

history.summary: Inventoried combat candidates, documented shared formulas, added 16 reference scenarios and recorded the unresolved beam candidate set.

notes: No Java, Mixin, config, datapack, installed JAR or runtime behavior is changed.
unresolved: Runtime-only values and the exact reported beam ItemStack remain explicitly unresolved in the generated coverage and warning views.
